raw_response:
This small plot of beans is mine, and I plant it together with maize like I always do. Fertilizer is expensive and I save what little I can get for the maize plot, not for the beans — beans do not need much, and my mother always said they feed the soil themselves. I will put some manure from the goats because I have it at home, and I will use the seed I kept from last harvest since the improved bean seed at the agro-dealer is costly and I am not sure it does better here. My husband and I will work the plot ourselves, and maybe my older daughter helps on weekends; I do not have money to hire anyone for such a small piece.
